context_rotation: Fixed; rotated only via CI. Distinct from myco-self-euthanasia-v1 (M23.2) and myco-population-vote-v1 (L2_FEDERATION §6.5.e) to prevent cross-protocol replay.
signing_key: Substrate's federation signing key (identity-signing or derived sub-key; L1-tunable).
tofu_pinning: On first FED_HELLO from peer_substrate_id, verify Ed25519 with signer_pubkey; pin (peer_substrate_id, pinned_signer_pubkey, pinned_at_cycle). Subsequent HELLOs MUST match pinned key.

legacy_peer_fallback.trigger: Both signer_pubkey and hello_signature absent (pre-M25.4 peer).
legacy_peer_fallback.behavior: Accept under substrate-ID-TOFU only; emit federation_legacy_peer_pinned (not immune); pinned_signer_pubkey = None.
legacy_peer_fallback.consensus_eligibility: Consensus-passive (counted in §6.5.d N; contributes no votes).
legacy_peer_fallback.deprecation_horizon: L1 deprecation horizon (seed 12 wall-clock months); post-horizon → reject + federation_legacy_peer_horizon_expired.

mutual_asymmetry: Initiator HELLO → receiver verifies → HELLO_ACK signed → initiator verifies. Either-side failure → terminate + BOTH emit C39. Pinning per-direction (A pins B; B pins A).
burst_detection: Persistent same-IP C39 → federation_hello_signature_burst (L1-tunable; immune >10/hour). Detector: verify_fed_hello_signature.
